title: Brass band photograph
summary: They identify the men in a brass band photograph, including Kid Howard, Jim Robinson, Harrison Bradley, Tats Alexander and Noon.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel

blocks.x: And then you got a picture of the brass band with the D and Howard and Clayton and Jim Robinson and I think Eddie Summers you said?
No, not Eddie Summers, Harrison Bradley. Harrison Bradley, yeah.
On tenor. Tats Alexander. On Alta. Tats Alexander. On Alta. Tats Alexander and uh Noon and me.
Noon's playing too, is it all right?
Uh-huh. Was that a pretty steady standard band or did you use different bands? Wasn't that? Yeah, yeah.
